_comment: Catalyst pool — three per phase, one slot each per character, once per match. Every catalyst is a free action (see docs/design/free-actions-and-catalysts.md). Entries are AbilityDef-shaped so validateAbility can be reused. Selection is an M3 lobby feature; the default triad until then is second_wind / shift / adrenaline.

prep.name: Second Wind
prep.description: Heal 30 immediately. The emergency button: read their burst, survive it, and still take your turn. (Once per match)

prep.name: Ablative Field
prep.description: A 35-point shield for this turn — larger than any kit's. Pre-empt the burst you predicted. (Once per match)

prep.name: Brainwave
prep.description: Energized for 3 turns: +50% energy from everything you do. Buy your ultimate roughly two turns early. (Once per match)

dash.name: Shift
dash.description: Blink up to 3 squares, ignoring walls. Does not consume your Move — this is extra distance, not instead of. (Once per match)

dash.name: Fade
dash.description: Untargetable for the turn without moving an inch — you keep your position and your attack. The answer to being read. (Once per match)

dash.name: Unshackle
dash.description: Unstoppable for 2 turns: walk out of Root and Slow, ignore knockback and pull. The answer to a control kit. (Once per match)

blast.name: Adrenaline
blast.description: Might for 2 turns (+25% damage) — and it lands before this turn's attack, not after. (Once per match)

blast.name: Suppression
blast.description: Every enemy within 2 squares is Weakened for 2 turns. Blunt the counter-swing instead of raising your own. (Once per match)

blast.name: Overdrive
blast.description: Might and Haste for a turn. The Might lands on this turn's attack; the Haste lands on the Move right after it. Hit hard, then leave. (Once per match)
